## Problem and change

What problem does this solve, and how does the behavior change? Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

Describe the relevant checks you ran and their results. For dictation changes, distinguish unit tests, synthetic audio and real-microphone testing. Include a redacted screenshot for visible changes.

## Limits

Note anything untested or any known limitation. Keep test-only hooks out of shipping builds and preserve editable input without automatic Enter or a clipboard round trip.

Please remove credentials, personal recordings and private prompts before submitting.
